description: Send a message to Adorbis AI and get a response. Adorbis auto-routes to the best available model based on the selected department. Use this for general AI assistance, questions, and conversations.

department.description: AI department to use: 'adorbis/quick' (fast responses), 'adorbis/coder' (code), 'adorbis/auto' (smart routing), 'adorbis/write' (writing), 'adorbis/reason' (analysis)

message.description: The message or question to send to the AI

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set context for the AI
